when.quote: When a customer's savings account interest calculation is incorrect, agents must submit an interest discrepancy report to the backend team for investigation.

steps.quote: 1) Verify the customer's identity and account ownership

1) Verify the customer's identity and account ownership

steps.do: Compare the accounts and cards the customer mentioned with the records. If they differ (for example, a card they do not hold), ask the customer to clarify. Use only the products shown in the records.
steps.if: the customer's description of their products differs from the records
steps.quote: 1. Identify all checking accounts the customer holds

steps.do: Look up the savings type's docs and add up the expected APY: base (and tier) rate + the HIGHEST linked-checking boost from a qualifying pairing + the HIGHEST credit card bonus + any relationship bonus. Example for a Gold Account savings: base 5.5%; Green checking +0.75%, Purple checking +0.1%; card bonuses from the Gold Account table, e.g. EcoCard +0.6%, Platinum Rewards +0.15%, Gold Rewards +0.025%; Gold Rewards Card relationship bonus +0.025%.
steps.quote: 5) Calculate the expected APY by adding all applicable components

steps.do: Work out the APY that was actually applied from the interest credited and the balance. Find out which checking boost or card bonus the system used, for example a lower checking boost instead of the highest one.
steps.quote: 3. Verify that the system is applying the highest boost, not a lower one

steps.do: Explain to the customer which boost or bonus was wrong, the correct APY, and the difference in interest. Offer the interest correction credit and the discrepancy report.
steps.quote: 4. If the system selected the wrong checking account, calculate the correct APY and apply an interest correction

steps.if: a discrepancy exists and the customer agrees
steps.quote: 7) If a discrepancy exists, first apply a credit using apply_savings_account_credit_6831 to correct the customer's account

steps.do: Credit the interest difference to the savings account

args.arguments: {account_id: the savings account id, amount: expected interest minus actual interest, credit_type: 'interest_correction'}

steps.quote: credit_type (string): Must be one of 'interest_correction', 'fee_refund', or 'goodwill_credit'
8) Then submit the discrepancy report using submit_interest_discrepancy_report_7294

args.arguments: {account_id: the savings account id, user_id: the verified user's id, expected_apy: expected APY as a number, actual_apy: applied APY as a number, amount_difference: the credited difference}

steps.quote: Important: Always apply the credit to the customer's account BEFORE submitting the report.

steps.do: Tell the customer the credit amount, the new balance, and that the report has been submitted
steps.quote: 6) Inform the customer of the applied credit and new account balance

rules.rule: Checking account boosts do not stack: only the highest boost from a qualifying checking account counts for the savings type
rules.quote: Only the highest applicable checking account APY boost is applied to the customer's savings account.

rules.rule: Credit card bonuses do not stack: only the highest card bonus counts. It does stack with the checking boost and with relationship bonuses.
rules.quote: Only the highest applicable credit card APY bonus is applied to the customer's savings account.

rules.rule: Only listed checking and savings pairings earn a boost. Green checking + Gold savings and Purple checking + Gold savings both qualify.
rules.quote: Note: Only these specific pairings qualify for the linked checking account APY boost.

rules.rule: Gold Account savings base APY is 5.5%
rules.quote: Your account earns an APY of 5.5% on the balance you maintain.

rules.rule: Green checking boosts a Gold savings account by +0.75%
rules.quote: Savings APY boosts apply when you link an eligible Gold or Silver Savings Account: +0.75% or +0.25% respectively

rules.rule: Purple checking boosts a Gold savings account by +0.1%

Credit card bonuses on a Gold savings account: Bronze +0.15%, Silver +0.2%, Gold Rewards +0.025%, Platinum Rewards +0.15%, Diamond Elite +0.3%, EcoCard +0.6%, Green Rewards +0.35%, Crypto-Cash Back +0%
rules.quote: Holding certain Rho-Bank credit cards provides bonus APY on your Gold Account balance.

rules.rule: Gold Rewards Card holders get a 0.025% relationship bonus on a Gold savings account, added to the base rate
rules.quote: As a Gold Rewards Card holder, you receive an additional 0.025% relationship bonus APY on top of the base rate.

rules.rule: Gold savings interest compounds daily and is credited monthly
Apply the credit before submitting the report

jobs.done_when: The customer is verified and logged. The interest_correction credit for the difference has been applied to the savings account. The interest discrepancy report has been submitted with the expected APY, actual APY and amount difference. The customer has been told the credit amount and the new balance.

Only the highest credit card bonus applies; it stacks with checking boosts and relationship bonuses
Checking and savings pairings that qualify for a boost
get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 returns accounts with type, balance and status
get_bank_account_transactions_9173 fields, including the interest_credit type
Gold Rewards Card relationship bonus of 0.025%
Table of credit card APY bonuses for a Gold savings account
Green checking boost of +0.75% for Gold savings
Purple checking boost of +0.1% for Gold savings

open_questions: No document gives the exact formula for a month's expected interest (balance × APY / 12 or a daily periodic rate). The Silver Account doc describes daily accrual, but the Gold docs only say interest compounds daily and is credited monthly.

For a Gold savings account, the Gold Rewards Card shows up both as a +0.025% credit card bonus (doc 014) and as a +0.025% relationship bonus (doc 013). It is unclear whether both can apply, for example when a higher card such as EcoCard already supplies the card bonus. Doc 013's example total of 6.0% does not match 5.5% + 0.025%.
No document says how to deal with a customer naming a card the records do not show. The records are treated as authoritative and the agent asks the customer to clarify.
